text:
Type: quilted reversible sherpa throw
Use: warmth draped over a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: micro mink plush face, sherpa fleece reverse, bound edges
Colors: warm taupe brown, matching sherpa side
Shape: rectangular, chevron quilted stitching, fleecy textured reverse, satin-like binding, medium weight
Feel: cozy, soft, warm
Goes with: cream, grey or brown upholstery, wood tones, knit cushions; farmhouse, rustic or contemporary rooms

product.name: Pinzon Quilted Reversible Micro Mink Sherpa Throw, Taupe
product.description: Reversible super-soft throw offers cozy warmth Chevron-quilted micro mink on one side dyed-to-match sherpa on the other Available in 3 colors: Chocolate, Gray, and Taupe Great for gift giving machine washable
